doc.button_prop_animateWidth: Whether to animate the width change when label changes
doc.button_prop_asChild:
If true, the button will be rendered as its child, merging its props onto that child.
Useful for using the button styles with Link components (e.g. from React Router or Next.js).
doc.button_prop_fullWidth: Whether the button should take up the full width of its container
doc.button_prop_icon: Icon name or custom icon element
doc.cascader_prop_allowClear: Whether to show a clear button when a value is selected

doc.cascader_prop_separator: Custom separator for the display value
doc.combobox_prop_fullWidth: Whether to take full width of parent
doc.counterTextarea_prop_counterPosition:
Position of the counter.
"bottom" (default) shows it below the textarea.
"overlay" shows it inside the textarea (bottom-right).
@default "bottom"
doc.counterTextarea_prop_showCount:
Whether to show the character count.
@default true
